text:
ترے کھل گئیاں—
ساون رات نہ چگیا،
ساون نہ واہیا،
پیکے گھر نہ سکھیا۔
romanized:
Tré khul geiā—
Sāwan rāt na chuggiā,
Sāwan na vāhiā,
Péké ghar na sikkhiā.
literal_en:
Three things are useless—
Cows not grazed at night in Sāwan,
Lands not ploughed in Sāwan,
Girls not taught in their parents' home.

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses
